2607.10633.title: Auditing Construct Overlap in Explainable Machine Learning: Evidence from Burnout-Depression Prediction Across Student Cohorts
2607.10633.paper_summary: Explainable machine learning (XML) pipelines applied to composite mental health outcomes can produce apparently-robust, cross-population-stable risk hierarchies that are largely artefacts of how the outcome was constructed. We demonstrate this using an ElasticNet pipeline applied to 886 medical students at the University of Lausanne (primary cohort, 2022), validated across 2,580 longitudinal observations at three time points and 701 non-medical students from eight faculties; all three datasets share identical instruments. The pipeline produces a hierarchy in which trait anxiety and health satisfaction dominate wherever the outcome is measured, with Kendall $τ= 1.0$ for the top-two positions across all five evaluation sets and consistent transfer performance ($R^2$: 0.41-0.49). Two residualization experiments, which isolate shared variance between correlated variables via regression, reveal the mechanism: when trait anxiety (STAI-T) is residualized against the co-included depression subscale (CES-D, $r = 0.72$), model $R^2$ drops from 0.41 to 0.16 and STAI-T falls from rank 1 to rank 6; when burnout subscales are residualized against CES-D, $R^2$ collapses to 0.016. Prediction intervals average 35.4 units on a 0-100 scale (2.4 outcome standard deviations), independently ruling out individual-level deployment. The residualization protocol is the paper's transferable contribution: any XAI study combining correlated predictor and outcome constructs should apply this check before interpreting apparent stability as a finding.
2607.10633.paper_summary_zh: 可解釋的機器學習（XML）流程應用於複合心理健康結果時，可能會產生表面上穩健、跨人群穩定的風險層級，這在很大程度上是結果構建方式的產物。<lb/>我們使用一個應用於洛桑大學886名醫學生的ElasticNet流程來證明這一點（主要隊列，2022年），並在三個時間點的2,580個縱向觀察和來自八個學院的701名非醫學生中進行驗證；這三個數據集共享相同的工具。<lb/>該流程產生了一個層級，其中特質焦慮和健康滿意度在所有測量結果中佔主導地位，所有五個評估集的前兩個位置的Kendall $τ= 1.0$，並且轉移表現一致（$R^2$: 0.41-0.49）。<lb/>兩個殘差化實驗通過回歸隔離相關變量之間的共享變異，揭示了機制：當特質焦慮（STAI-T）對共包含的抑鬱子量表（CES-D，$r = 0.72$）進行殘差化時，模型的$R^2$從0.41降至0.16，STAI-T的排名從第1位降至第6位；當倦怠子量表對CES-D進行殘差化時，$R^2$崩潰至0.016。<lb/>預測區間在0-100的範圍內平均為35.4個單位（2.4個結果標準差），獨立排除了個體層級的應用。<lb/>殘差化協議是本文的可轉移貢獻：任何結合相關預測變量和結果構建的XAI研究在解釋表面穩定性為發現之前，都應該應用這一檢查。
